prior_outcomes_seen: The five previous hand-selected synthetic fixed count tables and sensitivity limits B have been exposed; this new calibration simulation is not independent ecological confirmation.
ecological_target: One physical station and one original preselected daylength-matched date pair, early vs late solar phase bins: latent encounter-rate season-by-bin OR, not circadian state/photoperiod memory
observation_model: Detected independent Poisson cell means = externally known device operating hours E_(branch,bin) * latent encounter rate A_(branch,bin) * externally calibrated independent detection probability q_(branch,bin)
calibration_sample_model: Four independent per-bin/season binomial reference triggers: successes~Binomial(n,q_true), external to animal detections; reference sensor labels true opportunity times without error; one independent trigger per trial

combined_inference.calibration_interval: Four two-sided simultaneous Hoeffding confidence bands, eps=sqrt(log(8/alpha_cal)/(2n_reference_per_cell)), trimmed to [0,1], familywise miss probability <=alpha_cal via four-cell union bound; no asymptotic approximation
combined_inference.detector_crossproduct_upper: B=q_falling_early_upper*q_rising_late_upper/(q_rising_early_lower*q_falling_late_lower), infinite if either denominator lower is zero
combined_inference.under_null: true latent season-bin OR<=1, independent camera hourly effort crossproduct known, worst-case theta_count<=effort_OR * B
combined_inference.robust_test: exact nonrandomized upper-tail Fisher noncentral hypergeometric probability P_(theta_effort*B)(X>=observed) < alpha_test; if B infinite then HOLD/no rejection
combined_inference.lower_bound: Exact one-sided (1-alpha_test) lower confidence limit for detected-count OR divided by known effort_OR*B; report zero if B infinity
combined_inference.confidence_statement: At most alpha_cal+alpha_test overall false certification if independent calibration reference and animal process plus model assumptions hold; calibration and exact test error budgets not each 0.05

monte_carlo.fixed_conditional_margins: Original artificial 2x2 table season and bin totals N,K,D predeclared per truth scenario; generate X=falling_early from Fisher noncentral hypergeometric with theta=effort_OR * detector_OR * true_latent_OR

primary_measures: for each of 4 worlds×4 calibration n: joint q-band empirical coverage over 600 fixed-seed calibration samples
fraction of exact robust combined-alpha rejections for source-free known true null and known true alternative, independently generated fresh conditional animal events
number and fraction HOLD due to q lower bound zero
mean detector gamma upper bound including ∞ status separately, median finite B
naive uncalibrated one-sided Fisher rejection fraction at alpha=.05 shown only to diagnose false attribution; not a calibrated comparison
admission_gates: all four q intervals jointly cover true q with at least the mathematical Hoeffding Bonferroni 97.5% coverage assurance (analytic, not empirical test of threshold)
all exact Fisher null tail and confidence inversions respect alpha_test=.025
valid reference q in (0,1], all device hours positive; forbid positive events at zero effort

for true animal null, theoretical unconditional false certificate probability <=alpha_cal+alpha_test when independent calibration and animal data assumptions hold; numerical observed rate is not an exact guarantee
for null_detector_only, stronger calibration should expose theta_q≈2 rather than relabel it an animal effect
if q lower bound reaches 0, status HOLD rather than numerical division or guessed gamma
all simulated animal X values preserve original artificial season and bin margins exactly
the earlier PR247 uncalibrated B grid and frozen outcomes never reclassified
real EcoBank animal events, calibration triggers, independent camera operation logs and precise station coordinates unavailable and unopened
